definitions.explanation: The art and skill of calculating with a {そろばん} (abacus). Often refers to the school subject or after-school class where children learn this skill.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{珠算|しゅざん}{二級|にきゅう}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: She has a second-rank abacus certification.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}に{珠算|しゅざん}を{学|まな}んだおかげで、{今|いま}でも{暗算|あんざん}が{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: Thanks to learning abacus as a child, I'm still good at mental arithmetic.

notes:
{珠|しゅ} refers to the beads of the abacus; {算|さん} means 'calculation.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {珠算|しゅざん}{教室|きょうしつ}: abacus class/school
- {珠算|しゅざん}{検定|けんてい}: abacus proficiency exam
- {珠算|しゅざん}{大会|たいかい}: abacus competition

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
The abacus remains a popular after-school activity in Japan, valued for building number sense and mental-calculation speed. Proficiency is measured by ranked levels ({級|きゅう} and {段|だん}), the same grading system used in martial arts. Advanced students can perform large calculations mentally by visualizing the abacus.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- そろばん: the abacus itself (the physical device) — more common in everyday speech
- {暗算|あんざん}: mental arithmetic — calculation without any tool
